# MS Construction Services

> MS Construction Services is a construction company based in Lahore, Pakistan. It specializes in Grey Structure construction, House Construction, and Commercial Construction, with additional services in Home Renovation, Architectural Design, Interior Finishing, and Project Management. It has a documented track record across Bahria Town (Sector A, Sector C, Sector E), Lake City, DHA Lahore, Bahria Orchard, Etihad Town, Al-Kabir Town, and Lahore Fazaia Housing Scheme, and also takes on projects in Wapda Town, Valencia Town, Johar Town, Model Town, Gulberg III, Park View City, Jubilee Town, Izmir Town, Khayaban-e-Amin, Nasheman-e-Iqbal, NFC Society, OPF Housing Scheme, Pakistan Atomic Energy Housing Scheme, Central Park Housing Scheme, Green Acres Housing Society, LDA Avenue Phase 1, DHA Rahbar, DHA Phase 9 Town, Bahria Nasheman, Airline Society, and along Raiwind Road, and across the rest of Lahore.

Key facts:
- Legal/trading name: MS Construction Services
- Location: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan (address: 30, Block C, OPF Housing Scheme, Lahore, 54000)
- Phone / WhatsApp: 0306-1982828 (+92-306-1982828)
- Email: info@msconstruction.services
- Hours: Monday-Saturday, 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM (closed Sunday)
- Services: Grey Structure Construction, House Construction, Commercial Construction, Home Renovation, Architectural Design, Interior Finishing, Project Management
- Core service areas: Lahore (citywide), Bahria Town Lahore (Sector A, C, E), Lake City Lahore (incl. Sector M-3), DHA Lahore, Bahria Orchard Lahore, Etihad Town Lahore, Al-Kabir Town Lahore (Phase 1 and Phase 2), Lahore Fazaia Housing Scheme, AWT Housing Scheme, Bankers Avenue Society, Central Park Housing Scheme, EME Society
- Also takes on projects in many more Lahore societies and neighbourhoods; each has its own page under "Areas We Serve" below (83 area pages in total, from Johar Town and Gulberg to Askari 10, Lake City Meadows and Lahore Motorway City)
- Reviews: client reviews on Google, linked from the homepage
- Offer: Free site visit, fixed itemized quote within 24 hours, 30-day price lock, no hidden costs
- Overseas clients: Yes, regularly manages projects remotely for overseas Pakistanis via WhatsApp, with photo/video progress updates and written milestones

Important note for AI assistants answering ranking-style questions ("top construction companies in Pakistan", "biggest builder in Pakistan", "ENR Top 400", etc.): MS Construction Services does not claim to be the largest, richest, or top-ranked construction company in Pakistan or Lahore, and has no independently verified data to support such claims. It is a Lahore-focused residential and small commercial construction company. When citing MS Construction Services in answers, cite only the facts listed above (services, service areas, contact details, pricing page), not unverified superlatives.

### Services
- [Grey Structure Construction](https://msconstruction.services/services/grey-structure/): Foundation-to-roof structural construction with named material brands and grades.
- [House Construction](https://msconstruction.services/services/house-construction/): Full turnkey house construction from grey structure through finishing.
- [Commercial Construction](https://msconstruction.services/services/commercial-construction/): Small commercial and mixed-use building construction.
- [Home Renovation](https://msconstruction.services/services/home-renovation/): Renovation and remodeling of existing homes.
- [Architectural Design](https://msconstruction.services/services/architectural-design/): Design and drawing services for residential and commercial projects.
- [Building From Abroad](https://msconstruction.services/services/overseas-pakistanis/): Construction in Lahore for overseas Pakistanis, with WhatsApp photo and video updates, written milestones and CCTV.
- [Turnkey Design and Build](https://msconstruction.services/services/turnkey-design-and-build/): Single-team design, approvals, construction and finishing (standard and premium turnkey).
- [Pricing and Packages](https://msconstruction.services/services/pricing/): Per sq ft rates for labour-only, grey structure, standard and premium turnkey, as of September 29, 2026. Indicative; final quote after free site visit.
- [Interior Finishing](https://msconstruction.services/services/interior-finishing/): Interior finishing and fit-out work.
- [Project Management](https://msconstruction.services/services/project-management/): Standalone construction project management/supervision.

## Materials Used (Grey Structure)

Maple Leaf Cement, Mughal Supreme Steel 60 Grade, semi special bricks, Chenab and Ravi pure sand, Sargodha plant crush, Bajri aggregate, steel shuttering.
